title: Clown Horn
blurb: A double honk, several centuries of circus heritage, and a devastating verdict. Meme culture assigns this sound to anybody caught mid-clownery — a bad decision visibly in progress, a confidently wrong answer, an argument conducted at length with bait so obvious it was practically labelled. The bulb horn has stood for foolishness since long before the internet existed, and that lineage gives it an authority the newer options lack. It pairs beautifully with the clown-makeup meme, one layer applied at a time as the evidence accumulates. Honk honk.
origin: The classic circus bulb horn, meme shorthand for clown behavior.
